n: JBL Straight Line Array Column Loudspeaker
d: Straight Line Array Column with 16 x 2” Drivers and Constant Beamwidth Technology. Switchable 40° or 15° vertical coverage, music (flat)/speech switch, 100W multi-tap transformer or 8 ohms, 80 Hz - 20 kHz, 325W continuous pink noise, 100 cm tall (priced and sold individually) .

specs.label: Coverage Angle
specs.value: Vertical: Switchable, Narrow Mode: 15° (±10°), Broad Mode: 40° (±10°), Horizontal: 150°(±20°)

specs.label: Sensitivity
specs.value: Narrow: (speech mode) 96 dB (2 kHz - 14 kHz )(music mode) 93 dB (300 Hz - 18 kHz)Broad: (speech mode) 93 dB (2 kHz - 14 kHz)(music mode) 90 dB (300 Hz - 18 kHz)

specs.label: Power Capacity
specs.value: 325 W (1300W peak), 2 hrs 200 W (800W peak), 100 hrs

specs.label: Transformer Taps
specs.value: 120W, 60W, 30W (15W at 70V only), and 8Ω thru, via switch

specs.label: Enclosure
specs.value: Fiberglass reinforced ABS cabinet, painted aluminum grille

specs.label: Outdoor Capability
specs.value: IP-55 rated, per IEC529, when installed with optional MTC-PC2 panel cover. UV, moisture and 200-hr ASTM G85 acid-air/salt-spray resistant.

specs.label: Insert Points
specs.value: 18 M6 insert points on back panel.
